ContainedObjects.LuaScript:
-- LOBO MAP ROTATION FRAME BEGIN
local lmr={owner="707e8b"}
function lmr.flipped()
 local o=getObjectFromGUID(lmr.owner)
 return o and o.getVar('LOBO_MAP_ROTATION_FLIPPED')==true
end
function lmr.vector(p)
 return Vector(p.x or p[1] or 0,p.y or p[2] or 0,p.z or p[3] or 0)
end
function lmr.point(p)
 local v=lmr.vector(p)
 if lmr.flipped() then v.x=-v.x;v.z=-v.z end
 return v
end
function lmr.rotation(p)
 local v=lmr.vector(p)
 if lmr.flipped() then v.y=(v.y+180)%360 end
 return v
end
function lmr.getPosition(o) return lmr.point(o.getPosition()) end
function lmr.getRotation(o) return lmr.rotation(o.getRotation()) end
function lmr.setPosition(o,p,...) return o.setPosition(lmr.point(p),...) end
function lmr.setRotation(o,p,...) return o.setRotation(lmr.rotation(p),...) end
function lmr.setPositionSmooth(o,p,...) return o.setPositionSmooth(lmr.point(p),...) end
function lmr.setRotationSmooth(o,p,...) return o.setRotationSmooth(lmr.rotation(p),...) end
function lmr.positionToLocal(o,p) return o.positionToLocal(lmr.point(p)) end
function lmr.positionToWorld(o,p) return lmr.point(o.positionToWorld(p)) end
function lmr.getBounds(o)
 local b=o.getBounds();if b and b.center then b.center=lmr.point(b.center) end;return b
end
function lmr.getTransformForward(o) return lmr.point(o.getTransformForward()) end
function lmr.getTransformRight(o) return lmr.point(o.getTransformRight()) end
function lmr.getTransformUp(o) return lmr.point(o.getTransformUp()) end
function lmr.copy(p) local q={};for k,v in pairs(p)do q[k]=v end;return q end
function lmr.cast(p)
 local q=lmr.copy(p)
 if q.origin then q.origin=lmr.point(q.origin) end
 if q.direction then q.direction=lmr.point(q.direction) end
 if q.orientation then q.orientation=lmr.rotation(q.orientation) end
 local hits=Physics.cast(q)
 for _,hit in ipairs(hits or{})do
  if hit.point then hit.point=lmr.point(hit.point)end
  if hit.normal then hit.normal=lmr.point(hit.normal)end
 end
 return hits
end
function lmr.data(d)
 if not lmr.flipped()then return d end
 local t=d.Transform
 if t then t.posX=-(t.posX or 0);t.posZ=-(t.posZ or 0);t.rotY=((t.rotY or 0)+180)%360 end
 for _,s in pairs(d.States or{})do lmr.data(s)end
 return d
end
function lmr.getData(o) return lmr.data(o.getData()) end
function lmr.getJSON(o,...) return JSON.encode(lmr.data(JSON.decode(o.getJSON(...)))) end
function lmr.spawnObjectJSON(p)
 local q=lmr.copy(p);q.json=JSON.encode(lmr.data(JSON.decode(q.json)))
 if q.position then q.position=lmr.point(q.position)end
 if q.rotation then q.rotation=lmr.rotation(q.rotation)end
 return spawnObjectJSON(q)
end
function lmr.spawnObjectData(p)
 local q=lmr.copy(p);q.data=lmr.data(q.data)
 if q.position then q.position=lmr.point(q.position)end
 if q.rotation then q.rotation=lmr.rotation(q.rotation)end
 return spawnObjectData(q)
end
function lmr.spawnObject(p)
 local q=lmr.copy(p)
 if q.position then q.position=lmr.point(q.position)end
 if q.rotation then q.rotation=lmr.rotation(q.rotation)end
 return spawnObject(q)
end
-- LOBO MAP ROTATION FRAME END
function onLoad() self.setLock(true) end
-- BEGIN LOBO BASE-TO-TOP HEIGHT V1
-- Rendered model bounds already include the object's current scale.
-- Project the normalized renderer bounds onto vertical; world elevation is irrelevant.
local loboHeightTimer=nil
local loboHeightPrefix='Height (base to top): '
local function loboHeightBody(description)
 local s=description or ''
 if string.sub(s,1,#loboHeightPrefix)==loboHeightPrefix then
  local e=string.find(s,'\n',1,true)
  return e and string.sub(s,e+1) or ''
 end
 return s
end
local function loboHeightRefresh()
 if self.isDestroyed() or self.loading_custom then return false end
 local ok,bounds=pcall(function() return self.getVisualBoundsNormalized() end)
 if not ok or not bounds or not bounds.size then return false end
 local size=bounds.size
 if not size.x or not size.y or not size.z then return false end
 local right,up,forward=lmr.getTransformRight(self),lmr.getTransformUp(self),lmr.getTransformForward(self)
 local height=math.abs(right.y)*size.x+math.abs(up.y)*size.y+math.abs(forward.y)*size.z
 if height~=height or height<=0.001 or height==math.huge then return false end
 local description=loboHeightPrefix..string.format('%.2f in',height)
 local body=loboHeightBody(self.getDescription())
 if body~='' then description=description..'\n'..body end
 if self.getDescription()~=description then self.setDescription(description) end
 self.tooltip=true
 return true
end
local function loboHeightStop()
 if loboHeightTimer then Wait.stop(loboHeightTimer);loboHeightTimer=nil end
end
local function loboHeightBegin()
 loboHeightStop()
 if loboHeightRefresh() then return end
 local tries=0
 loboHeightTimer=Wait.time(function()
  tries=tries+1
  if self.isDestroyed() or loboHeightRefresh() or tries>=90 then loboHeightStop() end
 end,1,90)
end
local loboHeightPreviousLoad=onLoad
function onLoad(saved)
 if loboHeightPreviousLoad then loboHeightPreviousLoad(saved) end
 Wait.frames(loboHeightBegin,2)
end
local loboHeightPreviousState=onStateChange
function onStateChange(oldGuid)
 if loboHeightPreviousState then loboHeightPreviousState(oldGuid) end
 Wait.frames(loboHeightBegin,2)
end
local loboHeightPreviousHover=onHover
function onHover(color)
 if loboHeightPreviousHover then loboHeightPreviousHover(color) end
 loboHeightRefresh()
end
local loboHeightPreviousDestroy=onDestroy
function onDestroy()
 loboHeightStop()
 if loboHeightPreviousDestroy then loboHeightPreviousDestroy() end
end
-- END LOBO BASE-TO-TOP HEIGHT V1

local function loboZoneIndex(n,default)
 return type(n)=='number' and n==math.floor(n) and n>=1 and n<=7 and n or default
end
local function loboZoneVector(p)return Vector(p.x or p[1],p.y or p[2],p.z or p[3])end
local function loboInk(target,out,points,kind)
 if not target or target.isDestroyed() or #points<2 then return end
 kind=kind or 'deployment'
 local scale=target.getScale();local width=math.max(math.abs(scale.x),math.abs(scale.z),.000001)

  local a,b=loboZoneVector(points[i-1]),loboZoneVector(points[i])

  while span>0 and nextDot<=distance+span do
   local t0=math.max(0,(nextDot-distance-length/2)/span)

   stroke({{a.x+(b.x-a.x)*t0,a.y+(b.y-a.y)*t0,a.z+(b.z-a.z)*t0},

local rules=[[THE DIG  -  ITS SEASON 18
Mission reference: Infinity Mission Geist
https://infinitygeist.com/mission/s18_the_dig
Scenario based on Robert Shepherd's The Monday Signal mission.

MISSION OVERVIEW
Reinforcements-compatible. Retreat! applies. Each player uses one HVT and two Classified Objectives. Each completed Classified is worth 1 OP.

SCORING  -  MAXIMUM 10 OP
* Neutralize an already-analysed Hyperthermal Tech: 2 OP per Tech, up to three Techs / 6 OP.
* At game end, if you neutralized at least one Tech in every Game Round: 1 OP.
* At game end, if more Consoles carry your Player Token than the opponent's: 1 OP.
* Two Classified Objectives: 1 OP each.

DEPLOYMENT AND CONSOLES  -  THIS MAP
This is the 48 x 48 inch, 300-point setup. Players deploy in opposite corner zones, each measured as a 24-inch radius from its corner. Neither player may deploy a trooper in Silhouette contact with a Console or Hyperthermal Tech.

There are three Consoles on the other diagonal: one at table centre, and one 16 inches in each direction from centre. Use Console A tokens or 40 mm diameter objective scenery. The familiar consoles supplied with this map have 40 mm mission footprints.

The Deployment menu can show 24-, 28- and 32-inch corner arcs independently. Side A (blue) and Side B (orange) can be selected separately, together, or hidden. The 24-inch arcs define the actual Deployment Zones. The 28-/32-inch arcs are +4-/+8-inch measuring aids; displaying them does not enlarge the mission's Deployment Zones or change Tech-placement restrictions. Apply the relevant troop's deployment rules normally.

HYPERTHERMAL DIG  -  BEFORE ARMY DEPLOYMENT
Each player places three Hyperthermal Tech tokens. The player who kept Deployment places their three first.

Use 25 mm diameter Tech tokens or equivalent scenery. The WHOLE token must be more than 8 inches from BOTH players' Deployment Zones and from every other Tech token. It must be on accessible table ground, never on top of or inside scenery or a building. In a 150-point game these two spacing requirements are 4 inches instead.

Use the normal Infinity mod Hyperthermal Tech markers for player placement; this map creates no Tech models. Players choose positions that satisfy the restrictions above.

ANALYZE HYPERTHERMAL TECH
Short Skill. Labels: Attack, Scenario.

Who and where:
* A Specialist Troop must be in Silhouette contact with a Console that does not already have that player's own Player Token.

Resolution:
* Make a Normal WIP Roll. After failure, another attempt is allowed by spending another Short Skill.
* On success, remove the opponent's Player Token beside that Console and mark it for the active player.
* If the active player's total of analysed or neutralized Tech is still below three, the opponent chooses ANY currently unanalysed Tech token on the board to become analysed for the active player.
* Use distinguishable Player A/B tokens to show which player owns the Console and the analysed Tech. The choice of Tech belongs to the opponent, not to the Specialist's owner.

NEUTRALIZE HYPERTHERMAL TECH
Short Skill. Labels: Attack, Scenario.

Any trooper may perform this task, provided it is in Silhouette contact with an analysed Tech bearing its OWN player's token. No roll is required. Remove that Tech token from the table after neutralization.

SPECIALIST TROOPS
For this mission: Hackers, Doctors, Engineers, Forward Observers, Paramedics, and troops with Chain of Command or Specialist Operative.

Repeaters and Peripheral (Servant) models cannot be used by Hackers, Doctors or Engineers to carry out tasks that require a Specialist Troop.

OPERATIONAL LEARNING
After a Specialist fails a WIP Roll for a Scenario-labelled Skill, continuing the SAME task in consecutive Orders gives:
* Second consecutive Order: +3 WIP.
* Third consecutive Order and later consecutive Orders: +3 WIP and +1SD.
These bonuses combine with other applicable Scenario-skill MODs.

The same Specialist must keep using the same Scenario Skill against the same target, without interruption. A successful roll, using a different Skill, changing target, or spending an Order on another trooper resets the sequence. Only one sequence may apply to a trooper for a given Scenario Skill at a time.

END OF THE MISSION
Play ends after the third Game Round. If a player begins their Active Turn in Retreat!, the game finishes at the end of that turn.

OTHER POINT LEVELS IN MISSION GEIST
* 300 / 350 / 400 points: 48 x 48 table; 24-inch corner zones.
* 200 / 250 points: 32 x 48 table; 20-inch corner zones.
* 150 points: 24 x 32 table; 12-inch corner zones; 4-inch Tech spacing.
This terrain remains the 48 x 48 setup; overlay selections do not resize it.

CURRENT WORDING
The task previously called Activate Console is Analyze Hyperthermal Tech. Console ownership and neutralization use Player Tokens; neutralization requires a Tech analysed for your own player. The small-game spacing exception applies at 150 points.

TERRAIN & ACCESS
Use the modeled geometry for line of fire and cover. The three open excavation pockets are 2.5 inches below street level and are 8 by 7 inches with two staggered ramps apiece; there is no tunnel network. Buildings have usable interiors and roofs. Taller buildings: state 1 roof on, state 2 upper floor exposed, state 3 ground floor exposed. Single-storey buildings: state 1 roof on, state 2 ground floor exposed. External roof ladders persist in all states. Rubble has no automatic special terrain effect.

SOURCE
Mission Geist: https://infinitygeist.com/mission/s18_the_dig
Official ITS mission: https://experience.corvusbelli.com/en/game-content/16de25e7-8317-4d7c-8438-bd4284164855]]
local function textHeight(text,width,size)
 -- TTS rejects the former long-string gmatch pattern ("pattern too complex").
 -- Only literal searches are used here, as in the working campaign controls.
 local chars=math.floor(width/(size*.54));local lines=0;local first=1
 while true do
  local last=string.find(text,'\n',first,true)
  local count=(last or (#text+1))-first
  lines=lines+math.max(1,math.ceil(count/chars))
  if not last then break end
  first=last+1
 end
 return math.max(590,lines*(size+7)+30)
end

 local nativeWait=loboNativeWait or Wait
 local busy=false
 local pending={}
 local missionReaders={}
 local grid=false
 local scoring=false
 local oldLoad,oldSave,oldDestroy=onLoad,onSave,onDestroy
 LOBO_MAP_ROTATION_FLIPPED=false
 local function deployed()
  local mat=getObjectFromGUID(config.anchor)
  if not mat or mat.isDestroyed()then return false end
  local p=mat.getPosition()
  return math.abs(p.x)<45 and math.abs(p.z)<27 and p.y>-10 and p.y<45
 end
 local function tell(color,message)
  if color then broadcastToColor(message,color,{1,.8,.35})else broadcastToAll(message,{1,.8,.35})end
 end
 local function owned(o)
  if config.guids[o.getGUID()]then return true end
  for _,tag in ipairs(config.tags)do if o.hasTag(tag)then return true end end
  return false
 end
 local function eligible(o)
  if o.isDestroyed() or o.tag=='Hand' or o.type=='Hand' or o.tag=='HandTrigger' or o.type=='HandTrigger' or (config.exclude and config.exclude[o.getGUID()])then return false end
  local p=o.getPosition()
  if p.y < -10 or p.y>80 then return false end
  if owned(o)then return math.abs(p.x)<=120 and math.abs(p.z)<=120 end
  if nereidDeckLifted==true then
   local deckX=LOBO_MAP_ROTATION_FLIPPED and -58 or 58
   if math.abs(p.x-deckX)<=24.25 and math.abs(p.z)<=24.25 then return true end
  end
  return math.abs(p.x)<=24.25 and math.abs(p.z)<=24.25
 end
 local function restoreLocks()
  for _,s in ipairs(pending)do
   if not s.o.isDestroyed()then pcall(function()s.o.setVelocity({0,0,0});s.o.setAngularVelocity({0,0,0});s.o.setLock(s.locked)end)end
  end
  pending={};busy=false
 end
 local function notify()
  loboLifeCall('loboUIStandardDirty',{})
 end
 local function drawGuides()
  local mat=getObjectFromGUID(config.anchor)
  if not mat or mat.isDestroyed()then return end
  local lines={}
  if scoring then
   for _,axis in ipairs({'x','z'})do
    local points={}
    for _,v in ipairs({-24,24})do
     local p=lmr.positionToLocal(mat,axis=='x'and Vector(v,0,0)or Vector(0,0,v))
     points[#points+1]={p.x,p.y,p.z}
    end
    loboInk(mat,lines,points,'scoring')
   end
  end
  for _,line in ipairs(lines)do line.loboStandardGuide=true end
  mat.setTable('LoboStandardGuides',lines)
  loboZoneWrite(mat,mat.getTable('LoboZoneSourceR1')or{})
 end
 function loboStandardState()
  return{mapName="Old Quarter Excavation - The Dig",flipped=LOBO_MAP_ROTATION_FLIPPED,grid=Grid and Grid.show_lines==true,scoring=scoring,busy=busy}
 end
 function loboStandardGrid()
  grid=not(Grid and Grid.show_lines==true)
  if Grid then Grid.show_lines=grid end
  notify()
 end
 function loboStandardScoring()
  scoring=not scoring;drawGuides();notify()
 end
 function loboStandardClear(player)
  if busy then restoreLocks()end
  local stage=getObjectFromGUID('2d647a')
  if (Global.getVar('hld')or 0)~=0 or (stage and stage.getVar('cb'))then
   tell(player and player.color,'Wait for the map to finish loading before clearing it.');return
  end
  if stage then stage.call('btnTrash');return end
  local snapshot={}
  for _,o in ipairs(getAllObjects())do
   if not(config.exclude and config.exclude[o.getGUID()])and owned(o)then snapshot[#snapshot+1]=o end
  end
  for _,o in ipairs(snapshot)do if not o.isDestroyed()then o.destruct()end end
 end
 function loboRotateMap180(player)
  local color=type(player)=='string'and player or(player and player.color)
  if busy then return end
  local stage=getObjectFromGUID('2d647a')
  if not deployed()or(Global.getVar('hld')or 0)~=0 or(stage and stage.getVar('cb'))then
   tell(color,'Wait for the map to finish loading, then rotate it.');return
  end
  local snapshot={}
  for _,o in ipairs(getAllObjects())do
   if eligible(o)then
    if o.held_by_color and o.held_by_color~=''then tell(color,'Release all battlefield pieces before rotating the map.');return end
    if o.loading_custom or o.spawning then tell(color,'Wait for the battlefield objects to finish loading.');return end
    snapshot[#snapshot+1]={o=o,p=o.getPosition(),r=o.getRotation(),locked=o.getLock()}
   end
  end
  if #snapshot==0 then return end
  busy=true;pending=snapshot
  local wasFlipped=LOBO_MAP_ROTATION_FLIPPED
  local ok,err=pcall(function()
   for _,s in ipairs(snapshot)do s.o.setLock(true);s.o.setVelocity({0,0,0});s.o.setAngularVelocity({0,0,0})end
   for _,s in ipairs(snapshot)do s.o.setRotation({s.r.x,(s.r.y+180)%360,s.r.z});s.o.setPosition({-s.p.x,s.p.y,-s.p.z})end
   LOBO_MAP_ROTATION_FLIPPED=not wasFlipped
  end)
  if not ok then
   LOBO_MAP_ROTATION_FLIPPED=wasFlipped
   for _,s in ipairs(snapshot)do if not s.o.isDestroyed()then pcall(function()s.o.setRotation(s.r);s.o.setPosition(s.p)end)end end
   restoreLocks();tell(color,'Map rotation could not finish; original positions restored.');print(tostring(err));return
  end
  local mat=getObjectFromGUID(config.anchor)
  if mat then loboZoneWrite(mat,mat.getTable('LoboZoneSourceR1')or{})end
  nativeWait.frames(function()if pending==snapshot then restoreLocks();notify()end end,2)
 end
 local function missionPanel()
  local id='loboMission_'..self.getGUID()..'_standardBriefing'
  local roots=UI.getXmlTable()or{}
  for i=#roots,1,-1 do if (roots[i].attributes or{}).id==id then table.remove(roots,i)end end
  local colors={};for c,on in pairs(missionReaders)do if on then colors[#colors+1]=c end end
  if #colors>0 then
   local body=LOBO_STANDARD_META.missionText or''
   local lines,start=0,1
   while true do
    local stop=string.find(body,'\n',start,true)
    local length=(stop or (#body+1))-start
    lines=lines+math.max(1,math.ceil(length/75))
    if not stop then break end
    start=stop+1
   end
   local height=math.max(440,lines*24+40)
   roots[#roots+1]={tag='Panel',attributes={id=id,rectAlignment='MiddleCenter',width='760',height='620',allowDragging='true',color='#10212AFF',active='true',visibility=table.concat(colors,'|')},children={
    {tag='Text',attributes={rectAlignment='UpperLeft',offsetXY='22 -12',width='580',height='38',fontSize='24',color='#FFFFFFFF',alignment='MiddleLeft'},value=LOBO_STANDARD_META.mission..' - Mission'},
    {tag='Button',attributes={id=id..'_close',text='Close',onClick=self.getGUID()..'/loboStandardMissionClose',rectAlignment='UpperRight',offsetXY='-20 -14',width='100',height='34',fontSize='18',color='#35566AFF'}},
    {tag='VerticalScrollView',attributes={rectAlignment='UpperLeft',offsetXY='20 -65',width='720',height='530',verticalScrollbarVisibility='AutoHide'},children={
     {tag='Panel',attributes={width='700',height=tostring(height),preferredHeight=tostring(height)},children={
      {tag='Text',attributes={rectAlignment='UpperLeft',offsetXY='10 -8',width='680',height=tostring(height-16),fontSize='18',color='#EDF3F8FF',alignment='UpperLeft',horizontalOverflow='Wrap'},value=body}
     }}
    }}
   }}
  end
  UI.setXmlTable(roots)
 end
 function loboStandardMissionOpen(player)if player then missionReaders[player.color]=true;missionPanel()end end
 function loboStandardMissionClose(player)if player then missionReaders[player.color]=nil;missionPanel()end end
 local function mount()
  if not deployed()or not loboLifeToken or not loboLifeAlive()then return end
  local roots=UI.getXmlTable()or{}
  local id='loboMission_'..self.getGUID()..'_standard'
  for _,n in ipairs(roots)do if n.attributes and n.attributes.id==id then return end end
  local children={}
  for _,item in ipairs({{'mission','Mission','loboStandardMissionOpen'},{'rotate','Turn 180','loboRotateMap180'},{'grid','Grid','loboStandardGrid'},
   {'scoring','Quadrants','loboStandardScoring'},{'clear','Clear Table','loboStandardClear'}})do
   children[#children+1]={tag='Button',attributes={id=id..'_'..item[1],text=item[2],onClick=self.getGUID()..'/'..item[3],width='326',height='34'}}
  end
  roots[#roots+1]={tag='Panel',attributes={id=id},children=children}
  UI.setXmlTable(roots)
 end
 function onLoad(saved)
  LOBO_MAP_ROTATION_FLIPPED=false
  if saved and saved~=''then
   local ok,state=pcall(JSON.decode,saved)
   if ok and type(state)=='table'and state.__loboStandard==1 then
    grid=state.grid==true;scoring=state.scoring==true
    LOBO_MAP_ROTATION_FLIPPED=state.flipped==true;saved=state.original or''
   end
  end
  -- Recover old two-map rotation envelopes nested inside color saves.
  local function unwrapRotation(text)
   if type(text)~='string'or text==''then return text end
   local ok,state=pcall(JSON.decode,text)
   if not ok or type(state)~='table'then return text end
   if state.__loboMapRotation==1 then
    LOBO_MAP_ROTATION_FLIPPED=state.flipped==true;return unwrapRotation(state.original or'')
   end
   if type(state.original)=='string'then state.original=unwrapRotation(state.original);return JSON.encode(state)end
   return text
  end
  if oldLoad then oldLoad(unwrapRotation(saved))end
  Wait.condition(function()if Grid then Grid.show_lines=grid end;drawGuides();mount();notify()end,
   function()return deployed()and loboLifeToken~=nil end,60)
  Wait.time(mount,1,-1)
 end
 function onSave()
  if busy then restoreLocks()end
  return JSON.encode({__loboStandard=1,flipped=LOBO_MAP_ROTATION_FLIPPED,grid=Grid and Grid.show_lines==true,scoring=scoring,original=oldSave and oldSave()or''})
 end
 function onDestroy()
  if busy then restoreLocks()end
  if oldDestroy then oldDestroy()end
 end
